description: This file serves as an entry point for running a FastAPI application with Uvicorn. It includes functions to ensure the project root is on sys.path for correct module importing, and a main function that launches the server with environment-configurable options.

methods.name: None _ensure_project_root_on_path()
methods.description: Ensures that the project root directory is added to sys.path so that project modules can be imported regardless of the current working directory.

methods.name: None main()
methods.description: Launches the Uvicorn server targeting the FastAPI application located at src.api.main:app, with configurations specified through environment variables.
